_contract: The review's 65 proposed glyphs, minus the 36 the product adopted on 2026-09-04, minus `thin-lines`. `thin-lines` is NOT here and must never be re-added: it is art for a command deleted six weeks ago (no such field on RenderOptions, no such command in the tree). Carrying it is how a deleted feature comes back as a picture of itself. Geometry contract unchanged from the delivery: 48x48 viewBox, stroke 2.5 currentColor, round caps and joins, fill none. `p` = path d strings drawn with the contract; `x` = raw markup for the deliberate exceptions. `verdict`/`why` are from GLYPH_ADOPTION.md, except the three `alias` entries, which that file omits and which are recorded here instead.

actual-size.why: view.zoom_actual registers with no icon. The adopt gate was open and the refusal names this shape verbatim.

bring-forward.why: A registered absence: it needs a content-stream reordering primitive the engine does not have.

calculated.why: The role is a CollapsingHeader, which has no icon slot.

eye.why: Every visibility control in the build is a native egui Checkbox, which has no icon slot.

fill-colour.why: Fill is not a gap — it is a decision recorded AGAINST in three files and reserved to the operator.

first-page.why: There is no on-screen first-page control. The status bar's page group is ⏴ n / N ⏵ and nothing else.

flip-pages.why: Duplicate home: this and wheel-flip are two proposals for the same single control.

help.why: There is no Help command, no help dialog and no documentation target anywhere in the build.

insert-pages.why: Draws upload.svg today (mapping.rs:271, shared with import-form-data). In neither of GLYPH_ADOPTION.md's lists.

last-page.why: As first-page: End is a keystroke owned by app::keyboard, not a command with an icon slot.

line-width.why: The control ships as a drag value over the pen's own units; it has no icon slot and no id to carry a key.
line-width.x: <path d="M8 12h32" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M8 35h32" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

merge-files.why: The command already has dedicated art — Icon::Combine. Taking this one would be a restyle.

modified.why: The unsaved-edits marker is a settled copy decision with three stated grounds, and it rejects this shape by name.

move-page-down.why: pages.move_down draws with chevron-down today; deferred as a pair with move-page-up.

move-page-up.why: pages.move_up draws with chevron-up, which is that glyph's own role, not borrowed art.

note.why: Every candidate home for a caution triangle is a place this project has already ruled against an icon.

opacity.why: The live opacity editor is a label row in a surface that draws no icons.

overflow.why: The overflow marker draws text by argument, across three surfaces. Three dots would be a second answer.

paste-in-place.why: No such command, and deliberately none coming — it is in the registered-absence table.

pin.why: Tear-out/keep-floating was unregistered on 2026-08-17: the dock has no floating mode at all.

properties.why: Draws document.svg today (icons/catalog/mapping.rs:234). In NEITHER of GLYPH_ADOPTION.md's two lists.

reset.why: No draw site (a CollapsingHeader), plus a second independent reason that would stand even if there were one.

select-all.why: edit.select_all registers with no icon. The gate was open; the refusal names the delivered shape.

send-backward.why: With its twin: blocked below the GUI on the same missing engine primitive.

set-scale.why: Draws convert.svg today (mapping.rs:277). In neither of GLYPH_ADOPTION.md's lists.

stroke-colour.why: Colour is not a command and cannot take an icon — refused in writing at manifest/markup.rs:27-33.

tab-order.why: The role genuinely exists and genuinely draws no icon — it is a CollapsingHeader.

zoom-readout.why: The one control in the application with a written, argued refusal that anticipated a completeness drive.
